_comment: Diplomacy (docs/DIPLOMACY.md). cards: id -> name, expression (reason/inspire/flatter/demand), push (bar points toward whoever plays it), cost and gain (expression points). The parley window shows no Demand pool (its column stays empty), so cards should use reason/inspire/flatter. deck: a new character's cards; slots: strategy bar size (cards beyond it wait in the repertoire until dragged to a slot; the layout is saved per character). parleys: per-NPC setups referenced by mobs.json "parley": offer (the option text, shown with the type and its expression icons), presence (the number shown after them; presumably the presence needed, display only), type (entertain/convince/interview/gossip/incite), npc_cards, npc_pools (starting expression points), lines (the NPC's replies, one per round), win_at / lose_at (bar 0..21, starts at 11), reward (xp, coin, card: a card id added to the deck on the first win, faction {id: amount}). Placeholder data (docs/CONTENT_EDITOR.md).

reward.flag_text: Word of your bargaining with Orin spreads around the camp.
